scenario.params: All seven current typed catalogue defaults; no preset or schema overrides.
scenario.inputs: Owned documented standalone fixtures; no live media, CSS bridge, pointer updates or DOM attachment. The separate M5 attached-field gate measures those DOM costs.
scenario.clock: one fixed 1/60 s update per rAF; 150 actual updates, queue completion and timestamp readback awaited
scenario.quality: DPR 1, physical 512-square presentation, resolution scale 1, adaptive quality disabled, timeScale 1
scenario.timing: CPU encode, encoding-through-queue-completion wall latency, summed actual per-pass GPU timestamps and observed rAF cadence measure separate boundaries. Serialized timestamp readback contributes to cadence. Logical allocation sizes are not VRAM; machine load is uncontrolled.
